runs.text: Six anthems around Israel. Only one is named Hope. What does each one sing about? Egypt: you have my love and my heart. Hope, freedom, and sacrifice, at war or peace. Jordan: long <<ˈ|l|ɪ|v>> the King, and his armies. Lebanon: our sword and our pen. And God. Syria: guardians of the homeland, peace be upon you. Then hopes, martyrs and blood. The Palestinian Authority's anthem, <<f|ɪ|ˈ|d|ɑ|i>>: one who sacrifices himself. Wars, blood, and the volcano of my revenge. And Israel's <<h|ɑ|t|i|k|ˈ|v|ɑ>>, sung the day the state was born: To be a free people in our land. Land, hope, freedom. No God, no king. And the only one with no sword, no blood, no enemy, no army. Most were written in fights for independence. <<h|ɑ|t|i|k|ˈ|v|ɑ>>, by a poet with no state. Which anthem would you sing? Six anthems. Only one is named Hope.
